about: Shared test vectors for props::clean (docs/M5-DESIGN.md §4.7, §5.2), read by dif-db's tests (crates/dif-db-core/src/props.rs) and the SDK's. Each case gives an event's props, the props stored, as [key, value] pairs in byte order of the UTF-8 key, and the dropped keys with their reason, in the same order. Numbers compare as f64, -0 apart from 0. The limits are docs/limits.json.

vectors.name: each type is kept as sent
types are never coerced
null and arrays are absent, not dropped
one level flattens as a.b
an empty object stores nothing
an object below one level is dropped
a collision drops the key
a collision drops the key even when the values agree
a collision with a deeper object drops the key
an absent value does not collide
keys starting with $ are reserved
an empty key is dropped, an empty part is not
an empty top-level key can flatten
keys with control characters are dropped
keys are at most 128 bytes of UTF-8 after flattening
strings are at most 1024 bytes of UTF-8, and never cut
numbers are f64, and -0 keeps its sign
the first 64 keys in byte order are kept; dropped and absent keys do not count
byte order is UTF-8's, not UTF-16's
stored props fill 8192 bytes of JSON exactly, escapes counted
keys are taken in byte order until one would cross 8192 bytes
props sent as an array store nothing
props that are not an object store nothing
props null store nothing
